approved: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill would require voters to show proof of identity before casting a ballot in a federal election or referendum.
Voters without acceptable identification could have their identity attested by another enrolled person or cast a declaration vote.
The bill would start the day after it receives royal assent.
Requires electors to display a proof of identity document before voting.
Allows voters without acceptable identification to use an attester or cast a declaration vote.
Amends the Commonwealth Electoral Act 1918 and the Referendum (Machinery Provisions) Act 1984.
Voters in federal elections and referendums.
